rules.name: SourceRequired
rules.rule: Every material factual claim must reference at least one evidence record.

rules.name: SourceDateRequired
rules.rule: Statistical and strategic evidence must carry observation/publication period.

rules.name: TerritorialFit
rules.rule: Evidence geography must fit the target geography; national/regional evidence used for local need requires explicit corroboration or extrapolation label.

rules.name: PopulationFit
rules.rule: Evidence population must match target age, education route, cohorts and qualifications sufficiently to support the need.

rules.name: SampleConsistency
rules.rule: Survey N must be identical across methodology, narrative, charts and project form unless versioned and explained.

rules.name: EntityConsistency
rules.rule: Project, school, beneficiary and partner identities must be globally consistent.

rules.name: ChartTextConsistency
rules.rule: Chart values, totals, legends and narrative values must reconcile exactly.

rules.name: SurveyPopulationCoverage
rules.rule: Surveyed cohorts must overlap funded cohorts and coverage/response rate must be reported.
rules.fixture: IX-XI surveyed vs X-XII selection base

rules.name: Freshness
rules.rule: For labour-market and education-flow indicators, evidence older than three years at submission must trigger a newer-source search and explicit stale-data justification if retained.

rules.name: SourceTraceability
rules.rule: Every evidence item must retain source institution, document/dataset identity, table/page when applicable, period, retrieval status and URL/document pointer.

rules.name: NeedEvidenceMinimum
rules.rule: Every priority need needs at least one direct supporting evidence item; high-priority needs should have an official or primary corroborating source.

rules.name: NeedInterventionTrace
rules.rule: Every funded activity maps to one or more evidenced needs, and every priority need maps to an activity/result/indicator or is explicitly out of scope.

rules.name: UnsupportedNormativeNeed
rules.rule: Horizontal principles such as nondiscrimination cannot be presented as empirically observed target-group needs without direct evidence; otherwise classify them as compliance/cross-cutting requirements.

rules.name: ContradictionResolver
rules.rule: Conflicting values are preserved as contradictions and never silently selected or averaged.

rules.name: TemplateContamination
rules.rule: Stray institutions, projects, education levels or demographic groups from unrelated templates are detected and rejected.

rules.name: BenchmarkCompatibility
rules.rule: Comparisons require compatible indicator definitions, denominators, age bands, geographies and time windows.

rules.name: SurveyQuestionResultIntegrity
rules.rule: Response labels and scale semantics must match the exact question; totals must equal sample/valid-response count or missing data must be reported.

rules.name: EvidenceApplicabilityScore
rules.rule: Compute applicability from source tier, territory fit, population fit, recency and directness; weakly applicable evidence cannot independently support a priority need.

rules.name: CausalityGuard
rules.rule: Descriptive association cannot be written as causal evidence without an appropriate design or external causal evidence.

rules.name: EvaluatorCoverage
rules.rule: Output must explicitly satisfy ETF 1.3-A/B/C and 1.4 requirements recovered from the approved evaluation scorecard.

rules.name: HistoricalCutoff
rules.rule: Historical blind run cannot consume post-submission amendments, later implementation outcomes or later statistics as if they were available at submission.

rules.name: SolutionLeakage
rules.rule: Need discovery must precede solution selection; a desired activity cannot be used as its own proof of need.

rules.name: NeedDeduplication
rules.rule: Semantically overlapping needs are merged or represented as dependency unless distinct evidence and causal paths justify separation.

rules.name: VersionedPopulation
rules.rule: Changes in school cohorts, qualifications or base population must be versioned; current population data cannot retroactively rewrite historical evidence.
